title: AQRU consumer yield platform launches
description: AQRU launched its consumer-facing crypto-yield platform around December 2021.
notes: A May 2022 first-party market announcement states that the platform launched five months earlier; 1 December is a sortable approximate date.

title: AQRU reports USD 50 million AUM and 20,000 signups
description: AQRU plc reported that the AQRU.io platform had exceeded USD 50 million in assets under management and 20,000 customer signups five months after launch.
notes: Operating-scale milestone rather than a customer-outcome event.

title: AQRU cuts yields and ends BTC and ETH interest
description: AQRU plc reduced yields to a maximum of 3% on the Maple product and stopped interest accrual on Bitcoin and Ethereum deposits while stating that customer assets remained available for withdrawal.
notes: The update reflected market-driven product contraction, not a withdrawal suspension or platform shutdown.

title: AQRU app business transfers to Langland Software Solutions
description: AQRU plc transferred its interest in the AQRU app, Maple Finance activities, and related technology businesses to Langland Software Solutions in exchange for a 30% stake, while stating that customers should not experience service disruption.
notes: Recorded as an ownership and operating restructure, not an acquisition, failure, or customer-repayment event.

title: AQRU remains live with narrowed product availability
description: AQRU's current site showed a USD 250,000 minimum balance, one displayed fixed-term receivables product, and multiple legacy crypto-yield products closed to new deposits.
notes: Current-state snapshot supporting limited status; availability remains jurisdiction-dependent.

title: YouHodler launches USDT savings account
description: YouHodler introduced a USDT savings account that credited platform users with interest on deposited USDT.
notes: First dated savings-product launch identified in the reviewed YouHodler sources.

title: YouHodler launches Bitcoin savings account
description: YouHodler expanded its savings-account product to Bitcoin deposits with platform-calculated interest.
notes: Product expansion within the continuing lending and wallet platform.

title: YouHodler moves savings payouts to weekly schedule
description: YouHodler announced weekly payouts for its high-yield savings accounts, replacing the prior monthly schedule.
notes: Payout-frequency change rather than a platform status change.

title: YouHodler documents current Yield Account operation
description: YouHodler's current guide described an active Yield Account with supported assets, account-level eligibility, weekly settlement, and user-controlled start and withdrawal actions.
notes: Current product-operation snapshot; rates, limits, assets, and jurisdictional availability can change.

title: YouHodler remains active under jurisdiction-specific terms
description: Current first-party materials described continuing lending, trading, custody, and yield services through Swiss and European entities with jurisdiction-specific restrictions and segregated-custody language.
notes: Status and legal-structure snapshot; it does not imply identical regulatory protections in every jurisdiction.
